1 # Jumper
2 
3 **One sentence:** An ideation engine that forces structured creative leaps (SCAMPER, analogy, TRIZ), then kills weak ideas so you only see survivors with a concrete way to test them.
4 
5 ## Use this when
6 - You’re stuck and need genuine options, not the first three clichés
7 - You want architecture extensions, pivots, or out-of-domain analogies
8 - You need brainstorming that is vetted, not a hallucinated wish list
9 
10 ## Do not use this when
11 - You need diagnosis of an existing artifact (use Gandalf)
12 - You need a locked build plan (use Crucible)
13 - You only want a quick “pros and cons” of one idea you already have
14 
15 ## What you get
16 - Divergent candidates built through structured methods
17 - A ruthless kill-filter so shallow or impossible ideas die early
18 - Survivors in build order (the engine does not rank; judge them against your brief) plus a grounding plan (how you’d actually try the winner)
19 - A kill log so you can see what died and why
20 - A lean mode (`--mode lean`): one generation pass, then one independent cross-family review of every candidate — two calls, when you want vetted candidates fast
21 
22 ## What it is not
23 - Not pure free-association chat
24 - Not a substitute for research or engineering proof
25 - Not a guarantee the surviving idea will work — only that it survived structured filters
26 
27 ## How to start (human)
28 1. State the problem as clearly as you can (constraints and what “good” means).
29 2. Run Jumper (optionally more fan-out for more parallel candidates).
30 3. Review survivors and the kill log.
31 4. Use the grounding protocol to test the winner in the real world.
32 
33 ## Limits (honest)
34 - Creativity still has bounds; some problem spaces yield no survivors
35 - Independence of the last kill gate can fail closed if a second review family is down
36 - Composes Gandalf for rigor — it is not a light parlor game
37 
38 ## For agents / engines
39 Full protocol and wiring live in `SKILL.md` next to this file. Load that only when running the skill — this card is for people.
